cold_scope: Two fresh hash-verified executable-directory copies, each followed by warm reuse. No OS-cache eviction or physical-machine cold-start claim.

execution_budget.queue_policy: Inspect at 15 queued minutes; one replacement only after the original is confirmed completed or cancelled.

failure_policy: No per-case retry. Any failed or partial batch rejects that native series; preserve all attempts and create a separately declared replacement after diagnosis.
scope: Exact private v0.4.0-rc.6 candidate series for pinned Taskell 1.11.4. 8 normal workflows and 12 semantic edge families; E11 is independently invoked as malformed input and fresh recovery, producing 21 contracts. First-use exploration is not final-series credit.

supersedes.reason: The provider-read-back Linux V35 report showed the full parser diagnostic wraps between “Could” and “ld” at the canonical 80-column viewport. The revised assertion checks the stable rendered suffix “not parse file.” while preserving the exact exit-1 assertion and unchanged-file state check. Earlier v1 failures remain retained.
